maxFileMB.description: New files above this size aren't snapshotted.

snapshotTimeoutSec.description: If one snapshot takes longer, snapshots pause for an hour in that project.

retentionDays.description: What zerostel prune removes by default.

exclude.description: Git pathspec globs that are never snapshotted.

watch.description: Files under your home folder to snapshot and rewind with every project, e.g. ~/.zshrc (up to 1 MB each).
